# Chart.js 4.5.1

- Bundle: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js
- License: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chartjs/Chart.js/v4.5.1/LICENSE.md (MIT)
- Upstream: https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js
- Unmodified pinned distribution; served locally, same as maplibre-gl.js/
  pmtiles.js — no build step, no npm dependency (AGENTS.md).
- Used for the elevation profile chart (docs/dev/elevation_profile_chart.md
  Tier 1) — one line dataset (distance_km on X, elevation_m on Y), no
  plugins.
